adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` handler, the code performs sequential DB round-trips via `await prisma.user.findUnique(...)`, then `await prisma.app.findUnique(...)`, then later `await prisma.credential.findFirst(...)`. At least the user and app existence checks are independent and could be parallelized (e.g., `Promise.all`) to reduce latency. This is a performance/efficiency concern rather than a correctness defect, and it is directly grounded in the diff.
